correctness.rationale: Complete independent 2^18-mask and recursive enumerations coincide on 714 faces; the 341-pair matching covers only legal incidences; a full 714-node, 2376-edge oriented Hasse DAG test proves acyclicity; signed integer gradient cancellation gives an identically zero 19-by-12 Morse differential. The resulting CW complex has one vertex, 19 three-cells, and 12 four-cells. Hurewicz implies the zero degree vectors make every four-cell attaching map nullhomotopic. Independent mod-2 simplicial reduction corroborates ranks, but is not used for the integral conclusion.

value.rationale: This is a natural first balanced cubic complete bipartite bidirected case after the path/cycle literature, with 18 directed edges and nine 2-cycles obstructing the standard acyclic reduction. The two distinct nonzero homotopy degrees, integral torsion-free wedge decomposition, and explicit zero attaching-degree certificate are meaningful structural facts not implied by the previously published polygon homology or one-way Euler series. It is an intentionally delimited special case, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
